items.title: Ukraine says nuclear plants reduced output after strikes on power grid
items.summary: Ukraine's Energy Ministry said nuclear power plants were forced to reduce electricity generation after overnight strikes damaged power stations, substations and transmission infrastructure. The plants themselves were not reported to have been directly hit.

items.title: DTEK reports over 41,000 customers without power in Odesa region
items.summary: Ukrainian energy company DTEK reported that an attack on one of its facilities in Odesa region left more than 41,000 customers without electricity. The outage adds to disruption from the wider overnight strikes.

items.title: Medvedev rejects proposal to trade Ukrainian territory for NATO membership
items.summary: Former Russian president Dmitry Medvedev dismissed the idea of Ukraine joining a revised NATO in exchange for territorial concessions as absurd. He reiterated Moscow's opposition to Ukraine entering the alliance and suggested that such a trade would be unacceptable.

items.title: Russia says it will raise Luhansk residential drone strike with UN and OSCE
items.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry plans to immediately submit materials concerning the reported Ukrainian drone strike on residential buildings in Yuvileine, Luhansk, to Russian representatives at the United Nations and OSCE, according to official Rodion Miroshnik. Local authorities earlier reported three deaths and six injuries.
